title: [AUG-180] Lift the transcript header above the body so the Export/Redo menus are no longer covered
why_we_need_this: On a completed session the Export menu (Copy with timestamps, Copy text only, Download .txt/.srt, Send to Praxis) and the Redo menu open downward and slide under the Action items panel, and under the corrections bar when a session has corrections. Users cannot reliably reach export actions, which are the main way out of a finished recording. Root cause (research AUG-170-nt7dsl): `.transcript-circuit-header` (@client/src/App.css ~L2483) creates a stacking context through `backdrop-filter` but has no z-index (level 0). The menus' `z-index: 100` (App.css ~L935, ~L1130) only applies inside that context. `.action-items-panel` (App.css ~L4489, `position: relative; z-index: 2`, added in AUG-165) and `.corrections-bar` (App.css ~L1278, sticky, `z-index: 2`, AUG-163) are later siblings in `.transcript-body`, so they paint above the whole header. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md (Bug Fix 1).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `.transcript-circuit-header` in @client/src/App.css gets `position: relative; z-index: 3;` (agreed option "Lift header"); no other z-index values are changed.
- [ ] On a completed session with action items, every Export menu item, including Send to Praxis, is fully visible and clickable over the Action items panel.
- [ ] The Redo menu (Boost audio, Russian, English, Auto-detect) is fully visible and clickable over the Action items panel.
- [ ] On a session with corrections, both menus are drawn above the sticky corrections bar.
- [ ] Layout overlays (AUG-154, z 44–47), pin toggles (z 45) and modals (Praxis/Settings, z 50) still draw above the transcript header.
- [ ] Checked in the Electron app on Windows; macOS uses the same Chromium stacking rules, and either a macOS check or a note "not checked on macOS" goes into the card.
important_constraints:
CSS only, a one-rule change; do not touch `.action-items-panel` or `.corrections-bar` (their z-index belongs to AUG-165/AUG-163 and the live/compact variants). Rejected options: removing the body z-indexes (undoes AUG-165/163, sticky bar could slip under lines); portalling the menus to document.body (40–60 lines of TSX plus outside-click rework). Compact mode is unaffected (.compact-dock replaces the UI). Research: AUG-170-nt7dsl. Roadmap: phase "Rodion feedback (Nov 2026)", M1 Quick fixes.

Mockup (before / after, built on the real stacking rules): @docs/mockups/AUG-170/index.html — https://claude.ai/artifact/FzXe7cy6bPmZo3a9qJuSNE

## Verification (2026-11-03)
- Done: @client/src/App.css `.transcript-circuit-header` now has `position: relative; z-index: 3;`. No other z-index changed. `npm run build` (client) exits 0.
- Electron app on Windows: checked by the user at close (2026-11-03).
- Not checked on macOS.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-03)

- Меню Export (Copy, Download .txt/.srt, Send to Praxis) и Redo на завершённой сессии больше не уходят под панель Action items и под sticky-бар исправлений.
- Оверлеи (44–47), pin toggles (45) и модалки (50) по-прежнему выше хедера.

Отвергнуто: снять z-index у тела (ломает AUG-163/165), портал меню в body (40–60 строк TSX + переделка outside-click).
